title: Short-assay signs give all-length ordering only under a qualified latent law
statement: Each fresh specimen draws one persistent hidden mode;given it,baseline stages and one action follow stationary conditional-independent response laws. For exactly two distinct propensities p_s<p_f and positive weights,d_n=w p_f^n Delta_f+(1-w)p_s^n Delta_s. Signs d0<0<d1 imply d_n>0 for every integer n>=1 without recovering atoms,weights or rare full yields. This is an ordering for sequence length L>=2,not its success probability. For arbitrary latent support,a separately qualified nondecreasing contrast Delta(P) plus E[P Delta]>0 gives E[P^n Delta]>0 via increasing tilts;four aggregated assays do not acquire monotonicity. Synthetic four-assay example uses20000fresh specimens/type=80000 and at most120000stage attempts;simultaneous99%Clopper–Pearson intervals put d0<0<d1 and certify all lengths only conditional on that structural law. The integrated300-state killed CTMC has actual trap returns,permanent degradation and persistent modes,with160000Gillespie specimens,at most240000stage attempts,338144.323model-time units and377972events. Its short intervals again separate the signs. Exact-hidden-generator sparse solve agreeing at L75 is a stronger-information oracle check,not an equal-data advantage. Physical two-mode/support/stationarity/action-response qualification and preparation/reset/readout are unpaid;data are synthetic and double endpoints are not formal outward certificates.

requires: Killed excursions need complete prepared boundary/gateway microstates,all failure routes,unchanged hidden excursions under admitted boundary actions,and rho(K)<1. Permanent exponential degradation gives a Laplace-discounted success interface,not a deterministic deadline CDF.

Task theorem needs exactly two distinct persistent propensities in[0,1],positive weights,fresh independent specimens,conditional stage independence and stable action responses;the alternate arbitrary-mode theorem needs a qualified monotone contrast.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: Charge every short assay,stage attempt and simulated physical reaction clock. Real preparation/reset/readout/action calibration remain unmeasured. Exact rational fixtures,float solves,statistical confidence and physical model qualification are distinct.
contract.units: Success probability,Laplace discount,all-length ordering,statistical confidence,physical reaction time,jumps and preparation costs remain separate.
contract.obstruction: Synthetic conditional construction,not physical qualification or independent scientific review. Complete support/microstate preparation,stable persistent-mode law or independently justified monotone response are essential and unlearned from four short assays. Exact three-mode aliases/rare contamination defeat generalization. No novelty,superiority,device,wet-lab or operational chemistry claim;previous held transfers remain excluded.
